description: Vide (centau/vide), the reactive Luau UI library for Roblox - components, sources, derive, effect, scopes, create(), show/switch/indexes/values, springs, context, and cleanup, plus laying UI out across phones, tablets, monitors, and TVs. Load it before writing, editing, reviewing, or debugging any Vide UI; for any code that requires Vide or calls create, source, effect, root, or mount; when building a ScreenGui, BillboardGui, or SurfaceGui from code in a project that uses Vide; when UI has to fit different screens or devices (UI scaling, mobile or touch layouts, UI that overlaps, runs off the screen, or looks too small); and on errors such as "cannot create a new reactive scope inside another reactive scope". Load it even for a one-line UI change.

results.query: Opening my shop menu throws "cannot create a new reactive scope inside another reactive scope". What does that mean and how do I fix it?

My coins label shows the right number when the UI first opens and then never changes. It's a Vide component: local function coinLabel(props) return create("TextLabel")({ Text = `Coins: {props.Coins()}` }) end. What am I doing wrong?
Write a Vide health bar component for the HUD that smoothly animates down when the player takes damage.
What's the Vide way to show either the Shop page or the Inventory page depending on which tab is selected?
The block picker hotbar covers the jump button on my phone and looks tiny on my 1440p monitor. How do I make it fit every screen size?
Add a settings menu with a music volume slider and a toggle for shadows. All the UI in this game is built with Vide from ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Vide.
For a scoreboard that lists the players in the server, should I use indexes or values in Vide?

Can you review this for leaks? local function clock() local now = source(os.time()) RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() now(os.time()) end) return create("TextLabel")({ Text = function() return os.date("%X", now()) end }) end
How do I pass a color theme down through my Vide UI without threading it through every component's props?
In Vide, is it fine to use an effect that sets a total source whenever price or quantity changes, or is there a better way?
Our HUD is written with react-lua (jsdotlua/react). It looks tiny on 4K monitors and overlaps the thumbstick on phones. How should we scale it for different devices?
My Roact component calls setState inside didUpdate and now it re-renders forever. How do I stop the loop?
In Fusion 0.3, how do I use scope:Spring with a Computed to animate a frame's position when a value changes?
Write a plain LocalScript, no UI libraries, that uses Instance.new to make a ScreenGui with a Shop button that opens and closes a frame.
On the server, how do I make a Charm computed that adds up two atoms, coins and gems, and run a function whenever the total changes? There's no UI involved.
The controls panel in my UI Labs story comes out in a random order every reload. How do I group and order the controls?
Players on low-end phones get frame drops whenever lots of UI is on screen. How do I use the MicroProfiler to tell whether it's layout, text, or rendering?
In SolidJS, why does my createEffect run twice when I update a signal, and when should I use createMemo instead?
Add an Iris debug window that shows the local player's position and current block type, for testing only.
Write a critically damped spring module for my third-person camera so it follows the character smoothly without overshooting.
